# How a release ships

The figure below shows how a release ships, from the tag to the published
package, with a person approving before the publish step.

<!-- cf-figure: figures/release-flow.json -->

In the legend, the solid line means the step has already run, the dashed
line means it has not run yet, the filled dot is a step CI takes, the ring
is where the maintainer on call decides, and the bar is the gate that stops
the release when a check is red.

Every step after the tag runs in CI. The person who approves the release
is the maintainer on call.
